project.name: dreamstudio
project.productType: farm of installable micro-PWAs (85 apps) with a store as the launcher

assets: apps/<id>/icon.svg — 256² luminous light-on-black art, the app's identity

typography.label: mono, uppercase, tracking .18em, --ms-label — the ONE micro size
typography.rule: no numbers or units in reader-facing copy; imagery, not spec

shadows.raised: sf-raised sf-e2 (the lit rim on black)

motion.rule: respect prefers-reduced-motion; one orchestrated moment beats scattered effects

design.density: phone-first 384×832; a single scroll with islands, no horizontal page scroll

preferredPrimitives: Tile (icon on black with the lit rim)
patterns: colour = meaning (amber for featured/newborn, cyan for links)
labels outside clusters with a ground-colour knockout

must: read colours from theme tokens at runtime (getComputedStyle), never hardcode #fff
design both themes; the eye reads both before push
keep an accessible DOM mirror ([data-app] buttons) behind any canvas
no-op in the browser-free preflight (stub 2D context)
Preact + htm, no build; head.html is baked into index.html by scaffold --force
avoid: a tenth colour for categories — cluster + label instead
decorative gradients, glass, emoji, spinners, hint text
world-unit padding for labels — reserve screen pixels
fixed positioning inside the shell's flow (measure the page instead)

decisions.decision: The launcher is a night sky made of the apps' own luminous icons, clustered into constellations by category with outward labels; featured burn amber and larger, newborns breathe an amber ring; pan/pinch/wheel, tap opens the app Sheet. Search still flattens to the proven row list.
from21st: Constellation Grid (id 23960): spring-mass physics, dt normalisation, touch shockwave
Constellation Field (id 25569): pointer-reactive drift, distance-faded links
rejected: their anonymous decorative nodes — every node here is a real app
Interactive Globe (10073) — the globe app already owns that
a fixed-overlay canvas — the page is flow; measured 384×832
decisions.verified: vps/eye.sh check store: both themes, 85 apps, 0 overflow, 0 errors; tap→Sheet proven

evidence.fact: tokens measured on the live page
layout measured on the live page
